title: findings.json — output of every reviewer and guard (spec-conformance, security-authz, maintainability, plan-guard, architecture-guard, trace-auditor)

round.description: round ≥ 2 ⇒ scope must be the fix diff + previous findings only

previous_findings_status.description: round ≥ 2: verdict on each finding from the previous round

rule_ref.description: AC-<n> | conventions/<file>#<section> | constitution#<article> | CWE-<n> | contract:<path> — REQUIRED for any severity above OPINION

severity.description: BLOCKER: violates an AC, a constitution article, the contract, or a D-1 category (authz/data/UI) — blocks the gate. MAJOR: violates a convention with rule_ref, or UNSPECIFIED_BEHAVIOR — must be fixed or disputed before close. MINOR: rule_ref present, cosmetic/maintainability — fixed if cheap, else tech-debt issue. OPINION: no rule_ref — never blocks; shown to the owner in one batch.

type.description: UNSPECIFIED_BEHAVIOR = behaviour in code with no AC (mandatory type for spec-conformance reviewer); WEAK_ASSERTION = trace-auditor

evidence.description: quoted code / observed behaviour; opinions are not evidence

rule_candidate.description: if this finding can be generalised into a deterministic check

out_of_diff.description: round ≥ 2: finding outside the fix diff — allowed only as BLOCKER (constitution/security), otherwise goes to tech-debt
